segments.text: The theory of relativity, proposed by Albert Einstein in the early 20th century, revolutionized our understanding of

ics. It introduced the idea that time and space are not absolute, but rather relative to the observer's state of motion. One of its key components is the equation E=mc², which expresses the equivalence of energy (E) and mass (m) with c representing the speed of light. This groundbreaking concept has far-reaching

ts on both theoretical and applied physics, influencing everything from nuclear energy to our understanding of black holes. Furthermore, the implications of relativity challenge our intuitive notions of
and time, suggesting that these dimensions can be warped by gravity. This theory not only changed the landscape of modern physics but also inspired further research into the fabric of the universe.

academic.passage: The theory of relativity has fundamentally altered our approach to physics. It shows that measurements of space and time can vary based on the relative motion of observers. The famous equation E=mc² indicates that energy and mass are interchangeable. This revelation has influenced numerous fields including astrophysics, where it helps explain phenomena such as black holes and gravitational waves. Moreover, relativity challenges conventional ideas about how the universe operates.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: The theory of relativity has transformed physics.
Astrophysics is primarily about black holes.
The importance of energy in physics.
questions.explain: 這段文字的主要思想是相對論如何變革了物理學的理解。

questions.q: Which equation is associated with the theory of relativity?
questions.explain: E=mc²是相對論的核心方程，表達了能量與質量的等價性。

questions.q: What can be inferred about the theory of relativity's impact?
options: It is solely a theoretical concept.
It has led to developments in various scientific fields.
It is only understood by physicists.
questions.explain: 相對論的影響是深遠的，促進了多個科學領域的發展。

questions.q: What does the term 'warped' in the context of space refer to?
questions.explain: 在此上下文中，'warped'指的是空間的曲率或變形。

daily.passage: Attention students: The library will have extended hours during finals week. From Monday to Friday, the library will be open from 8 AM to midnight. We encourage all students to take advantage of this time to study effectively.
